dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Did you transport Silvermoon Hall all the way here for me?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hmm, no. Is it like a reflection in the water? How lovely. This brings back so many beautiful memories.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I suppose we're just missing my song now.
